summary: Largo Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. This is a routine periodic financial report required of foreign private issuers, corresponding to a US Form 10-Q. The filing includes standard statements of financial position, income, changes in equity, and cash flows, along with notes on operations, debt, and commitments. There are no disclosed events of a special-situation nature such as mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, or strategic alternatives. The filing is purely an earnings update with no actionable corporate event.
